lines.text: Many learners say: He said me a story.
Better: He told me a story.
Told! She told me the truth.

native.tip: نقول told me وليس said me: “He told me a story.” وليس “He said me a story.”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “He said me a story.” 😅 نقول told me وليس said me، فالجملة الصحيحة “He told me a story.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: Do you say “He said me a story”?
en.tip: We say told me, not said me: “He told me a story.” not “He said me a story.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “He said me a story.” 😅 We say told me, not said me, so the right sentence is “He told me a story.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
